threshold.source: pooled training out-of-fold scores of the selected configuration for each model

design: one stratified grouped nested 5x5 cross-validation, not repeated random splitting
baseline: constant training prevalence; all decisions negative
primary: mean of five outer-fold APs, population SD ddof=0; fold-level paired differences
secondary: summed confusion counts and pooled out-of-fold AP, with score-scale caveat
ties: first grid candidate by ParameterGrid order; higher F2 threshold
uncertainty: fold dispersion is descriptive; shared training sets preclude independent-fold inference
scope: retrospective development using a previously studied dataset; random groups are not timestamps or workfaces
